text.title: LLM Observability Stack — Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for applying `llm-observability-stack`. Each step lists input artifact, action, output artifact. Decision gates live in content/06-decision-tree.xml.

step.name: deploy-otel
step.action: Deploy OTel collector with attribute-processor for PII redaction.

step.name: deploy-langfuse
step.action: Deploy Langfuse with langfuse-stack.yaml; configure OTel-ingest.

step.name: deploy-prom
step.action: Wire Prometheus to scrape collector + langfuse metrics endpoint.

step.name: wire-instrumentation
step.action:
Add openllmetry / openinference / langfuse_handler per provider. Instrumentation rules:
Wrap every external LLM call in a span; include model name, provider, temperature, max_tokens
For streaming responses, record TTFT (time to first token) as a separate metric
Record cache hit/miss on every call to track prompt caching effectiveness
For agents: create parent span per agent run, child spans per tool call; include iteration count

step.name: wire-pricing
step.action:
Computes cost_usd per call; promql metric. Cost tracking patterns:
Use pricing.yaml to centralize model costs — never hardcode rates in application code
Track cost by team, environment, and feature via span attributes; bill back to owners
Budget allocation: production 70%, staging 20%, development 10% of monthly budget
Self-hosted break-even: ~30,000 minutes/month (500 GPU-hours); below that use APIs
step.reference: Model pricing config for cost calculation

step.name: wire-alerts
step.action:
alert-rules.yaml with page + warn tiers; route to PagerDuty / on-call. Beyond the r10 baselines:
Cost spike: hourly spend >150% of 7-day rolling average → warning
Quality drop: average quality score <3.5/5 sustained for 15 minutes → warning
Cache hit rate <20% for 30 minutes → info (investigate prompt variation)
All critical alerts → PagerDuty; warnings → Slack #llm-alerts channel
step.reference: Prometheus alert rules implementing all thresholds above

step.name: wire-agent-tracing
step.action:
Agent tracing patterns:
Record tool_name, input_args, output_size, and success/error for every tool call span
Log intermediate reasoning steps (thought content) as span events, not separate spans
Detect loops: flag when the same tool is called with identical args >2 times in one session
Store full conversation history in trace metadata for debugging hallucination root causes
step.output: Hierarchical agent traces with loop detection.
